_comment: Tier-2 for kratos.mpm pitfall #6: MPM boundary conditions attach to sub model parts of Background_Grid, never of MPM_Material. Executed 2026-08-07 on Kratos 10.4.3 Release with MPMApplication, using a self-written two-mdpa deck (no data files). Measured: the identical constraints_process_list block initialises when model_part_name is 'Background_Grid.DISPLACEMENT_fix' and raises RuntimeError 'Error: There is no sub model part with name "DISPLACEMENT_fix" in model part "MPM_Material"' followed by 'The following sub model parts are available:' when it is 'MPM_Material.DISPLACEMENT_fix'. The trap is that solver_settings.model_part_name IS 'MPM_Material', so the wrong root is the one a user naturally copies; the physical reason for the rule is that material points move while the grid does not, so a constrained region must be a grid region. Materials are the mirror image and address the body as 'Initial_MPM_Material.<name>'. SECONDARY VALUE: this is a live capture of the REAL Kratos missing-sub-model-part diagnostic. An earlier audit found catalog entries quoting an invented 'SubModelPart not found', a string that appears in zero files of the installed distribution; the genuine message enumerates the sub model parts that DO exist, which is the part that actually helps. INTERPRETER: needs a Kratos build carrying MPMApplication; set KRATOS_PYTHON. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): the mutation SWAPS the two model-part roots, so the deck expected to initialise now points at MPM_Material and the deck expected to fail points at Background_Grid; only the deck changes, the assertion machinery does not. Verified: unmutated PASSES (rc=0) with constraint_root_mismatches=0; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1), the count goes to 2 and both initialises[...]_expected=... lines flip. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/mpm_boundary_conditions_live_on_the_grid && $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py (fails). HARNESS FIX 2026-08-07: forbid_in_output was ['MISMATCH'], and the runner's matcher is case-insensitive SUBSTRING, so it also matched the '..._mismatches=0' line this fixture prints on SUCCESS. Every passing run was recorded as failed -- the fixture exits 0 and discriminates correctly (T2_MUTATE=1 gives rc=1), but the ledger showed FAIL. Narrowed to 'MISMATCH:' with the colon, which appears only in the real failure line and not in the counter. Nothing about the fixture's code or assertions changed. HARNESS FIX 2026-08-07: this fixture printed its assertion lines immediately after Kratos had written to stdout from C++ without a trailing newline, so the runner saw them glued to the tail of a Kratos log line (e.g. '::[MPMSolver]:: : Solinitialises[Background_Grid]=True_expected=True'). The runner's left-edge guard then correctly refused to match an assertion that does not begin a token, and every run was recorded FAIL although the fixture exits 0 and its mutation control still turns it red. A blank print() now forces a line boundary before the assertion block. No assertion, probe or expectation changed.
